assets.prompt: Official character turnaround model sheet of the llama gentleman from the first reference portrait: the same face, cream curly wool mane, tall pointed ears, calm half-lidded knowing eyes, faint closed-mouth smile; black textured dinner jacket with peaked lapels and white pocket square, black waistcoat, white pleated dress shirt, black bow tie. Layout like the second reference: five full-body views in a row on plain warm paper, front, three-quarter front, side profile, three-quarter back, back, all at the same scale and standing on the same ground line. His forelimbs come out of the white shirt cuffs as woolly llama forelegs that end in slender two-toed llama hooves with dark tips, exactly like the hoof holding the cards in the portrait. Hind legs are woolly llama legs with the same two-toed hooves. Short fluffy tail. Identical proportions, outfit and colours in every view. Fine 19th-century steel engraving, crisp black ink line hatching and cross-hatching on every surface, warm off-white paper, ink black with subtle muted sage and brass accents. Even, flat studio light, no text, no labels.
assets.notes: Second reference 5fd42651… is the 2K GPT Image 2.5 test sheet (media/tests/2026-11-09_image-model-ab/outputs/gentleman-turnaround_gpt-image-2.5_b.png).
